name: SymbolAtlas source contract; manually derived expectations

checks.name: Actual CMake sources: 12 files x 2 configurations
checks.sql: SELECT count(*),count(distinct source_file) FROM translation_units

checks.name: All selected translation units complete
checks.sql: SELECT quality,count(*) FROM revisions GROUP BY quality

checks.name: Compiler probes and excluded broken fixtures not modeled
checks.sql: SELECT f.path FROM translation_units u JOIN files f ON f.id=u.source_file WHERE f.path LIKE '%/fixtures/%' OR f.path LIKE '%/compileridcxx/%'

checks.name: Three authoritative link targets
checks.sql: SELECT name,kind,topology_authoritative FROM build_targets ORDER BY name

checks.name: Both executables depend on core
checks.sql: SELECT a.name,b.name FROM target_dependencies d JOIN build_targets a ON a.id=d.consumer_id JOIN build_targets b ON b.id=d.dependency_id ORDER BY 1,2

checks.name: Each selected TU belongs to one link target
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM target_memberships

checks.name: Two process entry identities remain distinct
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct logical_id) FROM symbols WHERE qualified_name='main'

checks.name: Runtime fixture strings do not become C++ symbols
checks.sql: SELECT qualified_name FROM symbols WHERE qualified_name LIKE 'atlas::engine::%' OR qualified_name LIKE 'bulk::partition_%'

checks.name: Shared header symbol unifies within each configuration
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.configuration_id,count(distinct s.id) n FROM symbols s JOIN occurrences o ON o.symbol_id=s.id JOIN revisions r ON r.id=o.revision_id JOIN translation_units u ON u.id=r.tu_id WHERE s.qualified_name='atlas::SourceRange' GROUP BY u.configuration_id HAVING n<>1)

checks.name: Forward declaration/definition share logical identity
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct s.logical_id),count(distinct o.role) FROM symbols s JOIN occurrences o ON o.symbol_id=s.id WHERE s.qualified_name='atlas::IndexStore' AND o.role IN (0,1)

checks.name: Resolver overloads stay separate
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct usr),count(distinct logical_id) FROM symbols WHERE qualified_name='atlas::Resolver::resolve'

checks.name: Diagnostic append overloads stay separate
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct usr) FROM symbols WHERE qualified_name='atlas::DiagnosticLedger::append'

checks.name: Static member definition unifies with declaration
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct s.logical_id),count(distinct o.role) FROM symbols s JOIN occurrences o ON o.symbol_id=s.id WHERE s.qualified_name='atlas::IndexStore::transactions_started_' AND o.role IN (0,1)

checks.name: Virtual diamond retains six distinct inheritance relations
checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.qualified_name,t.qualified_name,r.is_virtual FROM relationships r JOIN symbols s ON s.id=r.source_id JOIN symbols t ON t.id=r.target_symbol WHERE r.kind=12 AND s.qualified_name IN ('atlas::NamedEntity','atlas::LocatedEntity','atlas::IndexedSymbol','atlas::SyntheticEntity') ORDER BY 1,2

checks.name: Both describe overrides retain compiler relationships
checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.qualified_name,t.qualified_name FROM relationships r JOIN symbols s ON s.id=r.source_id JOIN symbols t ON t.id=r.target_symbol WHERE r.kind=13 AND t.qualified_name='atlas::GraphEntity::describe' ORDER BY 1

checks.name: Virtual base destructor override is represented
checks.sql: WITH RECURSIVE overrides(source,target) AS (SELECT source_id,target_symbol FROM relationships WHERE kind=13 AND target_symbol IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT o.source,r.target_symbol FROM overrides o JOIN relationships r ON r.source_id=o.target WHERE r.kind=13 AND r.target_symbol IS NOT NULL) SELECT count(*)>0 FROM overrides o JOIN symbols s ON s.id=o.source JOIN symbols t ON t.id=o.target WHERE s.qualified_name='atlas::IndexedSymbol::~IndexedSymbol' AND t.qualified_name='atlas::GraphEntity::~GraphEntity'

checks.name: App ingest call binds exact declaration
checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.qualified_name,r.resolution,r.dispatch FROM relationships r JOIN symbols s ON s.id=r.source_id JOIN symbols t ON t.id=r.target_symbol JOIN file_versions v ON v.id=r.file_version_id JOIN files f ON f.id=v.file_id WHERE r.kind=8 AND f.path LIKE '%/app/main.cpp' AND r.observed_target_spelling='ingest'

checks.name: Config-specific debug/release branches stay separate
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct r.revision_id) FROM relationships r JOIN symbols s ON s.id=r.source_id WHERE r.kind=8 AND s.qualified_name='atlas::Analyzer::summarize' AND r.observed_target_spelling='shrink_to_fit'

checks.name: Generated project header and version macro retained
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)>0 FROM macro_definitions m JOIN file_versions v ON v.id=m.file_version_id JOIN files f ON f.id=v.file_id WHERE m.name='ATLAS_VERSION_STRING' AND f.path LIKE '%/generated/atlas/build_config.hpp'

checks.name: Primary/partial/explicit template identities stay distinct
checks.sql: SELECT count(distinct usr) FROM symbols WHERE qualified_name='atlas::TypeDescriptor' AND (template_flags&8)=0

checks.name: Variable template declaration is retained
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)>0 FROM symbols WHERE name='has_qualified_name_v' AND kind=21

checks.name: StrongId member value calls bind compiler targets
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM relationships r WHERE r.kind=8 AND r.observed_target_usr LIKE '%@S@StrongId>%@F@value#%' AND r.target_symbol IS NULL

checks.name: Out-of-line defaulted destructor property is retained
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM symbols s JOIN occurrences o ON o.symbol_id=s.id WHERE s.qualified_name IN ('atlas::IndexStore::~IndexStore','atlas::GraphEntity::~GraphEntity','atlas::IndexedSymbol::~IndexedSymbol') AND o.role=1 AND (s.function_flags & 8192)=0

checks.name: App automatic IndexStore destruction is represented
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)>0 FROM relationships r JOIN symbols s ON s.id=r.source_id JOIN symbols t ON t.id=r.target_symbol JOIN file_versions v ON v.id=r.file_version_id JOIN files f ON f.id=v.file_id WHERE r.kind=10 AND s.qualified_name='main' AND t.qualified_name='atlas::IndexStore::~IndexStore' AND f.path LIKE '%/app/main.cpp'

checks.name: Unproved table index domain remains unknown
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM indirect_call_summaries WHERE complete<>0 OR domain_kind<>0

checks.name: All stored callbacks remain conservative candidates
checks.sql: SELECT s.qualified_name,count(*) FROM indirect_selectable_targets t JOIN symbols s ON s.id=t.symbol_id GROUP BY s.qualified_name ORDER BY 1
